implementation_status: LOCAL ONLY; automatic country modes require prepublication administrative and lawful-basis review. No deployment authorized.
US_rule: Conditional local auto only for CA/CO/CT/TX with trusted edge region metadata and processor/basic-only requirements. Maryland, Washington, all other US states and unknown US subdivision remain prior-consent pending review. Not a blanket US exemption.
AU_rule: Reasonably necessary ordinary nonsensitive analytics; APP 3/5/6/8 collection notice, minimisation, purpose and overseas accountability must be verified. Not an advertising/sensitive-data exemption.
JP_rule: Prior consent pending APPI recipient identification/linkage and foreign-transfer safeguards plus external-transmission disclosure applicability. No country-wide exemption assumed.
privacy_signals: GPC and DNT stop analytics in every country
geolocation: first-party Cloudflare /cdn-cgi/trace loc only, no IP storage; missing/invalid/timeout uses prior consent
state_geolocation: Prepared first-party /_ma/region endpoint reads request.cf metadata. No HTTP-header trust. NOT DEPLOYED. Trace fallback has country only, therefore cannot auto-enable US.
advertising: All three advertising consent parameters remain denied independently
